What happens to my image?

All processing happens in your browser. Images and settings are kept only in this tab’s memory; clear the image or close the tab to release them. Your image is never sent to Arcdrake. Optional counts and feedback use the separate controls below.

Downloads are newly encoded images. Original EXIF fields such as camera and GPS data are not copied. Visible details in the image are unchanged; this is not a redaction tool. Colour rendering may change when converting to standard browser colour space.

Still JPG, PNG and WebP images only, up to 40 MB, 40 million pixels, and 16,384 pixels per side. Animated files, SVG, HEIC and RAW are not supported. Small targets may reduce dimensions substantially. PNG keeps transparency but may need more resizing.

Feedback and optional usage counts

Feedback is available only when this site’s service can confirm receipt. If it is unavailable, your text stays in the form. Image processing works independently.
